Macklin Celebrini.summary: Celebrini scored two goals, one on an overtime power play, and added a power-play assist in Tuesday's 4-3 win over the Canadiens.
Celebrini scored a goal on seven shots and added two power-play assists in Saturday's 4-3 shootout loss to the Red Wings.

Evan Bouchard.summary: Bouchard scored a power-play goal on three shots, added two assists and went plus-2 in Sunday's 4-1 win over the Rangers.
Bouchard delivered two assists, including one on the power play, in a 7-2 loss to Toronto on Saturday.

Moritz Seider.summary: Seider notched two assists, two shots on goal, four hits and four blocked shots in Saturday's 4-3 shootout win over the Sharks.
Seider recorded a power-play assist, placed three shots on net, had four blocked shots and dished out a hit in Sunday's 3-2 loss to Winnipeg.

Jack Hughes.summary: Hughes scored two goals on seven shots and went plus-4 in Friday's 5-2 win over the Golden Knights.
Hughes scored a goal on six shots and added an assist in Tuesday's 5-1 win over the Stars.

Cutter Gauthier.summary: Gauthier scored three goals on five shots, with two tallies on the power play, in Sunday's 6-3 win over the Senators.
Gauthier scored two power-play goals on 10 shots and added a pair of hits in Thursday's 7-6 loss to the Sabres.

Dylan Guenther.summary: Guenther scored a power-play goal on three shots in Saturday's 5-4 overtime win over the Lightning.
Guenther scored a goal on two shots, added an assist, logged six PIM and went plus-2 in Tuesday's 5-4 win over the Maple Leafs.

Jakob Chychrun.summary: Chychrun notched two assists, four shots on goal and five blocked shots in Saturday's 4-3 overtime win over the Sabres.
Chychrun scored a power-play goal, recorded an assist, placed three shots on net and served two PIM in Friday's 5-2 win over the Hurricanes.

Alex Tuch.summary: Tuch scored a goal, added two hits and blocked two shots in Thursday's 4-3 win over the Predators.
Tuch scored two goals on a team-high five shots on net while adding one hit and a plus-3 rating in Wednesday's 5-2 win over the Flyers.

Jeremy Swayman.summary: Swayman will start Monday's home game against the Golden Knights, Adam Pellerin of NESN reports.
Jeremy Swayman.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Adam Pellerin (NESN)

Jeremy Swayman.summary: Swayman stopped 14 of 18 shots in Thursday's 4-1 loss to the Blues.

Brandt Clarke.summary: Clarke (upper body) is expected to play against Buffalo on Saturday, per Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site.
Brandt Clarke.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Zach Dooley (Kings')

Brandt Clarke.summary: Clarke (upper body) won't return to Thursday's game versus the Senators.

Tom Wilson.summary: Wilson scored an empty-net goal on three shots in Friday's 3-1 win over the Rangers. He also added three hits.
Wilson scored a goal on two shots, added two assists, logged two hits, blocked two shots and went plus-3 in Wednesday's 5-3 win over the Penguins.

Connor Bedard.summary: Bedard produced an even-strength goal and a power-play assist in Saturday's 5-4 overtime loss to the Bruins.
Bedard netted a goal Thursday in a 4-1 loss to Detroit.

Connor Hellebuyck.summary: Hellebuyck stopped 19 of 21 shots in Friday's 5-2 win over the Golden Knights.
Hellebuyck will start Friday's road game against Vegas, Amanda Stein of the Devils' official site reports.
Connor Hellebuyck.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Amanda Stein (Devils')

Pavel Dorofeyev.summary: Dorofeyev scored a goal in Sunday's 4-1 loss to the Oilers.
Dorofeyev scored a goal on four shots, added two PIM and went minus-3 in Saturday's 7-4 loss to the Senators.

Mark Stone.summary: Stone scored a power-play goal, added four hits and went minus-2 in Friday's 5-2 loss to the Devils.
Stone scored a shorthanded goal on two shots in Tuesday's 6-2 loss to the Lightning.

Justin Faulk.summary: Faulk scored a power-play goal on four shots, added two blocked shots and logged two PIM in Saturday's 4-3 shootout win over the Sharks.
Faulk scored the game-winning goal and added an assist in Tuesday's 5-3 win over Ottawa.

Gavin McKenna.summary: McKenna scored two power-play goals, dished an assist and added two PIM in Wednesday's 5-4 loss to the Kraken.
McKenna scored a power-play goal on one shot in Monday's 3-1 win over the Sharks.

Shea Theodore.summary: Theodore scored a goal and went plus-3 in Saturday's 6-2 win over the Penguins.
Theodore scored a goal on four shots and blocked two shots in Friday's 4-3 loss to the Ducks.

Joel Eriksson Ek.summary: Eriksson Ek recorded two assists, including one on the power play, and fired three shots on goal in Sunday's 5-1 win over the Capitals.
Eriksson Ek (undisclosed) is expected to play against Washington on Sunday, per Joe Smith of The Athletic.
Joel Eriksson Ek.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Joe Smith (The Athletic.)

Mikael Granlund.summary: Granlund scored a power-play goal on two shots in Thursday's 7-6 loss to the Sabres.
Granlund didn't record a point while putting two shots on net with a minus-2 rating in Monday's 5-2 loss to the Rangers.

Mackenzie Blackwood.summary: Blackwood stopped 25 of 27 shots in Saturday's 5-2 win over the Flames.
Blackwood is set to draw Saturday's home start against the Flames, per Jesse Montano of Guerilla Sports.
Mackenzie Blackwood.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Jesse Montano (Guerilla Sports.)

Simon Edvinsson.summary: Edvinsson (contract dispute) is on the Red Wings' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.
Edvinsson, who is a restricted free agent, has returned to Sweden to resume his training, per Andreas III Johnsson of Goteborgs-Posten on Wednesday.
Simon Edvinsson.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Andreas III Johnsson (Goteborgs-Posten)

Devon Levi.summary: Levi (undisclosed) is expected to miss a few weeks, per Jason Gregor of Sports 1440 Edmonton.
Devon Levi.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Jason Gregor (Sports)

Devon Levi.summary: Levi (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve Friday.

Charle-Edouard D'Astous.summary: D'Astois scored a goal on three shots, dished a power-play assist, added two PIM, levied five hits, blocked three shots in and went plus-2 in Friday's 6-3 loss to the Avalanche.
D'Astous scored a goal in Saturday's 3-1 win over Washington.
